summary: Regression retest after bug fixes. Backend: 51 pytest cases (serial, -n 0) — 51/51 PASSED, including all 5 new regression suites: brute-force lockout now returns 429 (never 500) after exactly 5 failed attempts and admin login recovers after login_attempts cleanup; negative daily_rate rejected (422) while 0 still accepted; invalid month params ('abc', '.*', '2026-1', '2026/01', '^2026', '2026-13-01') rejected with 400 on both GET /api/attendance and GET /api/recap while valid YYYY-MM works; future dates rejected with 400 on POST /api/attendance/manual and PUT /api/attendance/{id} while today is accepted. Frontend: admin login, add record, future-date rejection toast ('Tanggal absensi tidak boleh di masa depan'), delete confirmation AlertDialog (cancel keeps record — verified after reload; confirm deletes — verified after reload), Rekap & Gaji totals (Budi Santoso 1 hari / Rp 150.000), photo preview dialog served from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (/api/uploads/*.jpg returns 200 image/jpeg), employee page validation + successful submit + duplicate 409 message. All previously reported CRITICAL/minor defects verified fixed. DB restored to seed state (only Budi Santoso 2026-08-30, rate 150000) and db.login_attempts emptied.

minor.issue: allow_credentials=True combined with CORS_ORIGINS='*' — browsers reject credentialed requests with wildcard origin. Harmless today (auth uses Bearer token in localStorage, not cookies) but should use explicit origins if cookies are ever adopted.
Rate documents are never cleaned up; deleting all attendance rows for a name leaves an orphan rate doc (cosmetic/data hygiene, unchanged from iteration_1).
Still uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); migrate to lifespan handlers.

Optional: migrate on_event startup/shutdown to FastAPI lifespan.
critical_code_review_comments: Lockout fix verified: AsyncIOMotorClient(tz_aware=True) + email-only lockout key means the counter is no longer split across ingress proxy IPs; exactly 5 failed attempts then 429.
MONTH_RE validation now blocks regex injection into the $regex month filter — good; recap and attendance both covered.
No file-content sniffing on uploads (only content_type header + client filename extension) — still an accepted risk, not blocking.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -q -n 0` (serial matters: lockout tests mutate the shared db.login_attempts and would race with the configured -n 2). New class TestRegressionFixes covers lockout 429+recovery, negative rate, month validation, future dates. After any failed-login test always run db.login_attempts.delete_many({}). Auth = Bearer JWT in localStorage('admin_token'); no httpOnly cookies (playbook item 2 N/A). Frontend testids: attendance-submit-button / attendance-name-input / attendance-photo-input (employee), add-attendance-button, add-name-input, add-date-input, add-save-button, delete-attendance-button-{id}, delete-confirm-dialog, delete-cancel-button, delete-confirm-button, tab-data-absensi, tab-rekap-gaji.
rca_of_the_issue: Previous CRITICAL 500 in the lockout branch (tz-naive vs tz-aware datetime compare) is resolved by tz_aware=True on the Motor client; lockout key changed to email-only so the ingress proxy IP rotation no longer splits the counter. Verified end-to-end: 5x401 then 429, and normal login works again once login_attempts is cleared.
